Name: ChestFollowsYou
Author: kaniclub
Description:
[b]Chest Follows You[/b]
Chest Follows You is a simple mod that lets one chest follow you around like a cute little companion.

The followed chest can move with different companion avatars, collect nearby dropped items, and store them automatically.


[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]One chest can follow the player as a companion chest[/*]
[*]Adds a follow / stop-follow button to the chest menu[/*]
[*]Auto-collects nearby dropped items into the followed chest[/*]
[*]Companion avatar support[/*]
[*]Config support through config.json and GMCM[/*]
[/list]

[b]Companion Avatars[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Chest[/b] - The chest follows you using its normal chest appearance[/*]
[*][b]Junimo[/b] - A Junimo carries the chest[/*]
[*][b]Green Slime[/b] - A Slime carries the chest inside its body[/*]
[*][b]Rock Crab[/b] - A Rock Crab carries the chest like its shell[/*]
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Extract ChestFollowsYou into your Mods folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game[/*]
[/list]

[b]How to use[/b]
[list]
[*]Open a chest[/*]
[*]Click the follow button on the chest menu[/*]
[*]The selected chest will start following you[/*]
[*]Open the followed chest again and click the stop-follow button to place it back down[/*]
[*]When auto collect is enabled, nearby dropped items will be pulled into the followed chest[/*]
[/list]

[b]Configuration[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod[/b] - Turns the mod on or off[/*]
[*][b]Cross-Map Companion[/b] - Lets the followed chest move with you between maps[/*]
[*][b]HUD Messages[/b] - Shows a short message when follow is started or stopped[/*]
[*][b]Avatar[/b] - Changes the companion appearance used for the followed chest[/*]
[*][b]Auto Collect[/b] - Enables or disables automatic item collection[/*]
[*][b]Auto Collect Radius[/b] - Sets how far away dropped items can be collected from[/*]
[*][b]Move Speed[/b] - Adjusts how quickly the followed chest moves[/*]
[*][b]Stop Distance[/b] - Sets how close the chest gets before stopping[/*]
[*][b]Path Rebuild Interval[/b] - Controls how often the follow path is recalculated[/*]
[*][b]Full Indicator[/b] - Shows when the followed chest is full[/*]
[*][b]Companion Name[/b] - Shows the followed chest name above the companion[/*]
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer is not supported[/*]
[*]The mod disables its main behavior while playing in multiplayer[/*]
[/list]

[b]Source Code[/b]
The source code for this mod is available on GitHub:
[url=https://github.com/kaniclub/CHFO]https://github.com/kaniclub/CHFO[/url]

[color=#ffd966][b]If you enjoy this mod, I’d really appreciate an Endorsement — it helps keep me motivated to continue improving it.[/b][/color]
